decision: coordinator 0jx (10-19): C (layer-stride relative descriptors) + C2 (indexed routed-expert descriptors) + P2 (looped shape-generic programmes) + 2,048-word SM programme store
reroute_reason: rtl_change (SM service tile re-close accepted by the coordinator; critical: gate PNGs to COORD-REVIEW-QUEUE, no REVIEW.json / submit)
old_modules: untouched (byte-identical); every change is a new module

new_die_ports.svg.ids_v, ids_layer[7:0], ids[53:0]: router top-k broadcast (6 slots x 9-bit expert id) to the 16 issuers of the die; NEW die net from the router / top-k result (spec CF-IDXD); must arrive >= EXP_FIRST + n x block fetch before the first routed block go (compiler-checked; late = sticky issuer fault)

macros_per_SM: svg: programme 1 -> 2 x ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2, table 1 -> 2 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2; xc: same (+1 + 1 each). 16 SMs/die: +32 x 1024x256 + 32 x 128x256
latency: go -> first SM command 5 -> 7 edges (RELOC R stage + line-aligned C stage); format launch 1 edge before an op's first line (was 8); reserve pipeline +2 edges (elastic HBM side only)
attention_compilers: PREL programme words are LINE-ALIGNED (a line's cache read and its command in the same word; the feed lags the command one edge). The attention calendars (att_images / qwen_att_unit, VEH-ATT/ATTGAP) must move each read field one word later when they target the rel group; mode / format launch may come from the descriptor (mrel / fl).
finding_hbm_boundary: one SM streaming distinct-row 64-line blocks through svg + 4 controller leaves + DRAM fixture sustains ~160-170 edges a block (+ refresh stalls up to ~600): ~52 B/edge vs the 99 B/edge/SM price; sub-row slot packing (8 blocks a row index) measured slower (~290 edges/block). The bench paces at 200 edges / 64 lines.
finding_capacity: row-per-block placement: DS V4.1 token-resident blocks of one SM (384 experts x 43 layers x 2 + dense) ~ 34k row indices > 32,768; the 18-bit block address (row + 3-bit slot) fits, but slot packing costs fetch rate (above) -> PC controller bank-parallel ACT scheduling or a different block-to-bank map is owed (die lead / HBM service owner).
